source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Nadia, before hiring anyone, can you confirm whether you have resolved this exact type of profile-level Meta restriction before?

My Meta ad account cannot run ads, even though my personal account is already verified with two-step authentication and I have successfully run Facebook ads in the past. Meta initially said I needed 2FA. Support from Meta now says the problem is tied to my personal Facebook profile rather than the ad account because of “account integrity/authentic identity.”

value_updates.desired_outcome: restore the ability to run Meta advertisements through the existing personal profile and associated advertising account

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the existing Meta ad account cannot run advertisements despite identity verification, two-factor authentication, and previous successful ad activity; Meta support attributes the block to a personal-profile integrity/authentic-identity restriction.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: They explained on the call that it can’t be fixed because more than 365 days have passed. That’s the time allowed for an appeal.

execution.observed_behavior: Meta support reportedly determined that the existing advertising restriction could not be lifted because the 365-day appeal period had expired.

routing_warnings.description: The request for someone with administrator rights to manage advertising concerns ongoing campaign management rather than restoration of the existing profile's advertising access.
The client authorizes setting up another account, which belongs to the alternate-account Requirement rather than the existing-account restoration Requirement.
